section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedures for a Portuguese study, which is part of a larger research project. Participants were recruited via Facebook using a snowball sampling method and completed self-report measures. The final sample for this study consisted of 369 females, selected from an original sample of 392 individuals after excluding males and participants outside the 18-55 age range.
